q: What is a neighborhood market report?
a: It's a short, clear stat sheet for one West Linn neighborhood. It covers the median asking price, price per square foot, days on market, how many homes are currently for sale, and the twelve-month West Linn price trend. We refresh it every month from live listing data. Alongside it, the market reports page carries the city-wide sold figures from our monthly RMLS pull, so you can see what homes actually closed at, not just what sellers are asking. Sold data for a specific street or neighborhood is available on request.

Listing figures refresh automatically every month from live listing data, whose records originate from RMLS, and the city-wide sold figures come from an RMLS report Melissa pulls by hand each month, dated on the page so you can see how current it is. We never estimate or invent numbers, and where a figure isn't confirmed the page says so plainly instead of showing a guess.

q: Why is this site all about West Linn?
a: Because this is where Melissa lives, and knowing a market block by block, including school boundaries, the character of each pocket, and how Bolton differs from Skyline Ridge, lets us price and negotiate with real local evidence rather than broad regional averages. Lewis Realtors represents buyers and sellers across the greater Portland metro and Southwest Washington, and you'll find that work on our team site.

q: Do you help buyers as well as sellers?
a: Yes. We represent buyers, sellers, first-time homebuyers, investors, and buyers relocating to the area. Each service page links to the neighborhoods it fits best, so you can start where it matters to you.
Financing is handled by a mortgage partner we trust. When you're ready, we'll introduce you directly so you have a pre-approval in place before you start touring homes.

q: What happens after I request a report?
a: You enter your name and email, and the full report for that neighborhood is sent to your inbox. We're notified at the same time, so if you have a question about the numbers, a real local answer is close behind.
